TreeSpec(type: Any, children: Tuple['TreeSpec', ...] = (), context: Any = None, node_data: Any = None)

Part of [`evoxc.core`](/api/evoxc/core/)

Structural description of a pytree (frozen; structural equality).

## Attributes

- `type` · `Any` — The container type: `tuple`, `list`, `dict`, a namedtuple
  type, a dataclass type, or a registered custom type.

- `children` · `Tuple['TreeSpec', ...]` — Child `TreeSpec`\s (empty tuple for a leaf).

- `context` · `Any` — Optional metadata supplied by a registered type's
  `flatten_fn` (used by its `unflatten_fn`).

- `node_data` · `Any` — Optional per-type data needed to rebuild the container:
  sorted dict keys for `dict` (a `(default_factory, keys)` pair
  for `defaultdict`); field names for `namedtuple` and
  `dataclass`.

## children_specs

The child `TreeSpec`\s of this node (alias of `children`).

## num_leaves

Number of leaves described by this spec (1 for a leaf; 0 for an
empty container node).
